contract.definition: loanRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequests->any(lr: LoanRequest | lr.RequestID = id)
contract.postcondition: self.CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and ApprovalLetter.allInstances()->exists(al: ApprovalLetter | al.oclIsNew() and al.Content = 'standard content' and self.CurrentApprovalLetter = al and self.CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = al) and result = true
